display.purpose: Page titles and the lead card's competition name.

data.purpose: Finish times and any figure that is compared with another; tabular lining numerals.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Only for floating things: menus, tooltips, the quick-add button.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: All transitions; the lane lines of the lead card draw in 720ms with it, once per page.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action of a region.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0b57c4; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 20px; font: 600 15px Inter, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #083f93; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0b57c4; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #ffffff; color: #0c1a29; border: 1px solid rgba(12,26,41,0.3); border-radius: 8px; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 20px; font: 600 15px Inter, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #e4ebf1; border-color: #3a4f63; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0b57c4; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: PR Badge
components.description: Marks a personal record; gold is used for nothing else.
components.css: .ds-badge-pr { display: inline-flex; padding: 1px 7px; border-radius: 4px; font: 700 13px 'Barlow Semi Condensed', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #7a4f00; background: rgba(122,79,0,0.14); border: 1px solid rgba(122,79,0,0.55); text-decoration: none; }

components.name: Result Row
components.description: Distance, finish time with PR badge and opening split, gap to the previous PR with explicit sign.
components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 72px 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(12,26,41,0.14); font-family: 'Barlow Semi Condensed', sans-serif; } .ds-dist { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-time { font-size: 32px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; } .ds-row small { font: 13px Inter, sans-serif; color: #4f6478; } .ds-gap { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; color: #12703a; }

components.name: Lead Card
components.description: The one card per page that carries two lane lines along its top edge.
components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid rgba(12,26,41,0.14); border-radius: 12px; padding: 31px 24px 24px; color: #0c1a29; } .ds-card::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0 0 auto 0; height: 7px; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #0b57c4 0 2px, transparent 2px 5px, #0b57c4 5px 7px); } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0; font: 700 28px 'Barlow Semi Condensed', sans-serif; }

narrative.northStar: The Ice Sheet as a Plan
narrative.overview: SkateStats is read like a result sheet off the ice: flat, ruled, and exact. The ground is cool ice-white by day and night-ice navy after dark, type is ink-navy, and the only accent is lane blue.
keyCharacteristics: Flat and ruled: hairline borders, no shadows at rest, no gradients, no blur.
One accent (lane blue) for every action, link and focus; gold marks a record and nothing else.
Times and distances in the data face with tabular figures.
Phone first: bottom tab bar, 44px touch targets, the latest result before anything else.
Light, dark and system themes are each composed, not inverted.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Lane blue is the only accent. If something is blue it can be pressed or it is where you are.

rules.name: The Gold Means Record Rule
rules.body: Gold appears only on a PR. A gold element that is not a record is a bug.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Any figure that can be compared with another uses the data face with tabular, lining numerals.

dos: Do lead every result view with the latest result and its gap to the PR.
Do use tabular figures for every time, distance and count.
Do pair colour with a sign, arrow or word for every better/worse signal.
Do give risky actions an undo and long checks a visible status.
donts: Don't add glow, blur, gradient text or an ambient background layer.
Don't use gold for anything but a record, or blue for anything that cannot be pressed or is not the current location.
Don't make activity counts the headline; they are context.
Don't use emoji as icons; draw them in the 1.7px stroke family used by the navigation icons.
Don't nest cards or wrap every list in a card; rules and spacing group first.
